task.question: What is the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves?
task.evidence: 27 June — 2026 European heatwaves: The highest recorded temperature in Germany is taken in Möckern-Drewitz, measuring 41.5 °C (106.7 °F).

answer:
The highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was 38.5 °C (101.3 °F) in Kitzingen. 

FINAL: 38.5 °C
